description.purpose: A one-table memory: the episode surface every turn is written to, and the cell that answers the `memory_recall` tool in front of it. Two cells, one internal round trip, no model call anywhere in it.
description.use_when: As the smallest thing that can answer a `memory_recall` tool call, so an example can show the road of GH #552 working end to end.
description.not_in_scope: No extraction, no fact model, no ranking, no consolidation -- this hive stores what was said and answers questions about WHEN. Anything that reads meaning out of a turn is a different and much larger thing behind the same port.
